test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What does the MGNREGA stand for?

options.text: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Generation Act
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
Mahatma Gandhi National Regulated Employment Generation Act
Mahatma Gandhi National Regulated Employment Guarantee Act

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)** is a social welfare scheme enacted in **2005** by the Government of India.
 
• The purpose of this Act is to provide at least **100 days of guaranteed wage employment** in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
 
• It is one of the largest social security programs globally and aims to enhance the **livelihood security** of rural people by providing them with wage employment opportunities.
 
• The scheme is demand-driven, which means work is provided only when it is requested, ensuring its implementation is based on the needs of the people.
 
• The responsibility for the implementation of MGNREGA lies with the **Ministry of Rural Development**, Government of India, in collaboration with state governments.
